integrity: Proof and independent finite tests included; numerical checks do not replace the arbitrary-polygon proof.
scientific_limitations: Pointwise fixed nondegenerate polygon; no degeneration or large-side-count uniformity; eventual rather than all-threshold ordering. The arbitrary-polygon proof uses the classical Reuleaux arc-incidence property and uniform local dominance at corners. Historical priority remains provisional because Gates (1987) could not be inspected in full.
title: Two-term Crofton diameter tails and angular rigidity of Reuleaux polygons
